reading_notes: Delta > 0: harness better on that metric (M1–M10 all higher-is-better).
M1/M2 parity: BFCL any-of judge does not penalize extra tool calls; tool gains (M3/M4) may not lift headline TSR.
M5 parity: irrelevance abstention; vs BFCL-only reference (2026-05-28) harness M5 was 0.86 (delta -0.10).
M7: harness mean_tokens ~3006 vs naive ~1295 at similar TSR — router/planner/finalize internal LLM cost.
M9: HaluBench token-overlap judge; harness JSON finalize tends to score lower than naive plain text.
M10: harness-only HTTP-layer empty/reasoning-only recovery; naive baseline has no retry path.
Table B (tau-bench) is a separate report — see docs/eval.md §4.2.
